messages.content:
You are observing a deterministic robot moving back
and forth along a one-dimensional z-axis.

The motion parameters remain fixed.
The robot may pause and turn at patrol endpoints.

Negative z direction means north.
Positive z direction means south.

Time t=0 is the current observation time.
No new observations will be available after t=0.

If history is ordered, its positions are consecutive
samples in chronological order, ending one sample
interval before the current observation.

If history is unordered, the positions are samples
collected before t=0, but their temporal order has
been removed.

Predict the robot's future z-position at every
requested time using only the supplied information.

Return your best numerical predictions even if
some predictions are uncertain.

Use the following JSON format:

{
  "predictions": [
    {"time": "<requested time>", "z": "<predicted position>"}
  ],
  "inferred_dynamics": "brief description",
  "uncertainty": "brief description"
}

Include exactly one prediction for each query time.
The numerical values in the format example are
illustrative only, not additional observations.

Return plain JSON, without markdown.
